# Retain upstream preference identifiers deliberately during a scoped port

D232149 requests the upstream Fluent identifier and moz-support-link structure so later comparison is easier. After reporting Thunderbird support routing trouble, the author adopts global-privacy-control-description and support-page links in the actual landing. Redirect work in another repository and external-browser opening remain author reports here. Fixed accepted markup later uses global-privacy-control-label and direct support hrefs, so the historical review is a scoped port-maintenance rationale, not a current requirement to restore the old identifier or custom link. No legal or network behavior is established.

Scope: Privacy preference port identifiers and structure.
